sentences: A 'driving period' is the total driving time you build up from when you start driving after a rest period or a break until you next take a rest period or a break.
It can be continuous or broken up.
After a driving period of four and a half hours you must take an uninterrupted break of at least 45 minutes, unless you take a rest period instead.
You may split this break into a break of at least 15 minutes followed by a break of at least 30 minutes, spread over the driving period.
If you drive an occasional passenger service, you may instead take two breaks of at least 15 minutes each, spread over the driving period.
In multi-manning, you may take the 45-minute break in the vehicle while another driver drives, as long as you are not assisting that driver.

sentences: Keep the damaged card, together with any spare record sheet used to replace it.

While driving without the card you must make printouts:

On the printout write your name and your driver card or driving licence number, sign it, and add the periods required by Article 34(5)(b)(ii)–(iv).
